purpose: Deterministically compose exact-version lineage/subspecies deltas over a base SpeciesDefinition while surfacing semantic conflicts and delegating duplicate/stacking mechanics to shared owners.
preconditions: every lineage parent_species_ref exactly matches the selected base SpeciesDefinition identity/version
every lineage relationship is supported by explicit relationship_evidence_refs
every delta target exists or is explicitly authorized as an additive reference path
composition_algorithm: validate each selected lineage exact identity/version and parent relationship
sort lineages by layer_order then lineage_id then lineage_version for replay stability
sort each lineage operations by order then operation_id
group operations by semantic target before application
surface target collisions requiring semantic authority; stable order alone never chooses a winner
route duplicate/stacking/suppression/replacement mechanic interactions to owning shared records/profiles
emit definition-level composition result and conflict/handoff evidence without character runtime mutation

conflict_record_contract.rule: Unresolved conflicts block a fully composed definition-level result for the affected target; no last-write-wins or lineage-name precedence is invented.

required_when: same canonical record_ref appears from multiple species/lineage sources
